methods_quotes.q: All isolates underwent WGS using high-quality single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) analysis.
Guinea pig purchase invoices were used to trace guinea pigs with an epidemiologic link to human illness back to the distributor of origin.
State health departments were asked to review recent Salmonella Enteritidis illness records for patient exposure to guinea pigs.
